title: Floor tiling counts and two dependent callers
summary: Exact counts and parity share a helper. A changed base case and a discarded two-cell choice exercise both dependents.

change.description: Exact counts and parity share a helper. A changed base case and a discarded two-cell choice exercise both dependents.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 19 inputs on each revision. recursive mismatches were 0 for exact, 0 for parity. iterative mismatches were 0 for exact, 0 for parity. one-tile mismatches were 17 for exact, 6 for parity. base-change mismatches were 18 for exact, 13 for parity.

The oracle sums binomial coefficients. It gives 4,181 tilings of length 18. Dropping the two-cell choice first fails at length 2. The benchmark compares two consumers on the same compiled caller and captures cold and warm results when the helper's base case changes.
